pages.text: Press $(bold)F3$(). If the $(bold)server tick$() line is under 20 TPS, the server is busy: tell the group what everyone was doing. If TPS is fine and your $(bold)FPS$() is low, it is your machine: $(l:patchouli:faq/fps)more frames$(). Hold $(bold)Tab$() for the server's TPS and everyone's ping.
